main:
DELAY 1 S
PRINT starting
TIMING START
REPEAT 200 test for error
TIMING END C:\Users\kiera\Desktop\Civitron timing results
END

test for error:
GOTO create save
//DELAY 0.5 S
REPEAT 3 scroll
GOTO quit game
END

//clicks new game, types auto generated save and clicks done
create save:
MOVE 492 244
MOVE 493 244
MBP 0
MBR 0
MOVE 28 61
MBP 0
MBR 0
TYPE auto generated save
MOVE 36 166
MBP 0
MBR 0
END

quit game:
KBP 36
KBR 36
MOVE 29 59
MBP 0
MBR 0
END

scroll:
MOVE 850 200
MBP 0
MOVE 300 200
MBR 0
END
